integrity: The direct congruence argument proves the all-n statement. Exact finite checks \(n=3,5,7,9,11,13,15\) are supplemental, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only \(q=2\) and the last nonzero Cartier iterate. Intermediate ranks and complete Ekedahl--Oort types are not supplied. One-step Cartier action was published earlier; original 2009 construction full text was not accessed. Independent audit not performed.
title: The terminal Cartier rank of binary Serre-type maximal curves
